div.div:
360 degree model that can be exploded.
Gestures:
- double click/tap - explode/implode item under cursor
- mouse wheel or pinch - zoom in/out
In Simulation Mode, clicking on a key will depress the key and higlight:
- mechanical motion - orange border around moving parts
- electrical connectivity - electric blue moiving arrows with speed controls at bottom of page.
Moving the mouse around the parts will show info blocks for the current state of the part (hint box style)
NOTE: Models likely in STL format (if this is possible to use?) this is sort of like what most CAD aplications would do to build multiple parts into an assembly.
